proposed_rules.trigger: A FAQ accordion answer is rendered as a [region] node positioned outside its question's DOM subtree (surfacing as a page-root sibling like rc4/rc5) instead of nested under the question row.
proposed_rules.decision: Fold each promoted [region] answer back into the FAQ accordion block as the second cell of its matching question row, matched by vertical position, rather than emitting it as a separate block or default-content item.
proposed_rules.rationale: These are collapsed-accordion answers relocated by the capture tool's overlay/absolute-position promotion logic, not independent page content. Not addressed by the existing faq-accordion-block rule, which assumes inline nesting.

provenance.evidence: C219 rc4 [region] @47,4741 and rc5 [region] @47,4799 sit at page root, outside rc2c7c2 accordion container

proposed_rules.trigger: A bottom-of-page zone (rc3) with a tagline sentence ('The best no-code platform for ...') followed by a pipe-separated link list, identical across integration landing pages.
proposed_rules.decision: Treat as global site footer chrome, excluded from the page's per-page block inventory; model once as a site-wide footer fragment. (Rejected alternative: a per-page 'footer-links' block, which would duplicate identical content on every page.)
proposed_rules.rationale: Recurs verbatim across the health-integrations page family with identical structure, indicating shared site chrome rather than page-authored content.

notes: Standard Knack health-integration landing page: hero + capability/steps zones + use-case grid + compliance + CTA + FAQ accordion + footer, plus global nav/cookie chrome.
